divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

fasta: none for the manifest's run; the fasta and fasta-max10 sets pass the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's reference.fa.gz (chromosome 21, the corpus's transcript spans with N elsewhere) to both engines, decompressed for Ensembl VEP
input: 15 hand-built `<CNV:TR>` records (VCF 4.4) at 21:13620283, the padding base before the run TCATCATCA of a coding exon on the forward strand: a gain and a loss of one unit, an allele equal to the run, RB in place of RUC, no RN, two alleles, two SVLEN values, CIRUC, no RUS, a fractional RUC, a lower-case RUS, END without SVLEN, two repeat sequences in one allele, a `.` unit and a record with INFO/SVTYPE
generator: json_cache: the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's pruned cache; expected outputs: one Ensembl VEP 116.2 container run per format and per run (without a FASTA, with one, with one under --max_sv_size 10) on the committed records

fasta.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --uploaded_allele --allele_number --variant_class --mask_header_cache_path --fasta reference.fa [--tab|--vcf|--json]

fasta-max10.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --uploaded_allele --allele_number --variant_class --mask_header_cache_path --fasta reference.fa --max_sv_size 10 [--tab|--vcf|--json]
